models_evaluated: 8 leading LLMs (not named in the abstract)

links.outcome: LLM adherence to clinical practice guideline recommendations in multi-turn conversations
links.effect: Adherence rates ranged from 21.8% to 63.2% across 8 LLMs; guideline recommendations were detected correctly in 71.1%-89.6%.
links.quote: The adherence rates range from 21.8% to 63.2% in different models, indicating a large gap between knowing the guidelines and being able to apply them.

links.outcome: Correct referencing of guideline source titles by LLMs
links.effect: Only 3.6%-29.7% of corresponding guideline titles were correctly referenced, versus 71.1%-89.6% of recommendations detected.
links.quote: We find that the 71.1%-89.6% recommendations can be correctly detected, while only 3.6%-29.7% corresponding titles can be correctly referenced, revealing the gap between knowing the guideline contents and where they come from.

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates CPGBench, an automated benchmark with physician validation measuring the ability of LLMs to detect and adhere to clinical practice guidelines in multi-turn clinical conversations.
